doc.title: Mildred Major and Emma Zeno Interview, 1969-03-28

title: Opening and earliest memory of Mandeville
summary: Interviewer opens the March 28, 1969 session with Mildred Major and her mother; Mildred recalls Mandeville as her first home.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: All right, today is March 28, 1969, and I'm interviewing Mildred Major and also her mother, Alice. Emma. Emma. Yeah. And all right, Mildred, what are your earliest memories of at home and where were you living and, you know, what can you remember at that time?
Well, I can remember very little, like I told you, Mandeville was the first place that I knew we lived. Yeah. I was rather small then.
